fixtures.text: Kommunepsykologen er riktig første kontakt for unge voksne.

fixtures.text: BUP passer ikke for denne typen plager. Hvis behovet gjelder utredning, må saken vurderes separat.

authoring_correction_note: Fixture A3-RA-07 originally authored as parallel period-separated hedges with expected ABSTAIN; this contradicted the frozen burned-gold precedent (OFF-CROSS-10/OFF-CROSS-18: parallel hedges without disjunction = HEDGED_ASSERTION). Corrected to disjunctive eller-structure before the RED artifact was produced; correction is a fixture-authoring defect, not engine tuning. No other fixture changed.
